caption:
Can someone explain this? 😤

You find an error on your credit report, you dispute it, and the answer comes back "verified" with nothing changed.

Keep your proof, dispute in writing, and keep copies.

Has a dispute ever worked for you?
first_comment: Did your dispute get fixed or rejected? Tell us 👇

card.headline: Why does a dispute so often come back "verified"?
card.sub: Keep proof. Dispute in writing. Keep copies.
